I'd appreciate it if you lowered your guard...
My apologies. I sensed a powerful presence and thought it was an enemy...
strings.바르바토스가 물러나면서 불길한 기운은 다 사라진 것 같은데, 뭔가 느껴지: The sinister energy seemed to vanish when Barbatos withdrew. Do you still sense something?
strings.아닙니다. 제가 착각한 것 같습니다. 그런데 성역엔 무슨 일로 다시 오셨: No. I must have been mistaken. What brings you back to the Sanctuary?
I simply wanted to visit again.
strings.아르젠트가 복귀를 하지 않고 여기 있는 걸 보니 아직 그분들을 만나지 못: Since you haven't returned to your post, have you still not met those people?
No. Her Majesty did say it didn't matter whether I met them, but...
strings.별 건 아니고 개인적으로 찾고 싶은 것이 있어서 맹약의 성소 안을 둘러봤: Nothing serious. There was something I wanted to find for personal reasons, so I searched the Sanctum of the Covenant. I'm sure it's there, but I couldn't find it.
A black butterfly has been circling inside...
strings.바르바토스가 사라질 때 본 것 같은데, 그게 맞나요?: I think I saw one when Barbatos disappeared. Is that it?
strings.네, 그렇습니다…. 막내 황녀님을 이끌었던 그때도 그 나비가 그곳에 있었: Yes... That butterfly was there when the youngest princess was led away too.
strings.그게 있다면 바르바토스가 무엇을 했는지 알 수 있을 것 같습니다. 그리고: With it, I believe we could learn what Barbatos did. And find evidence against those who plotted treason that day.
I'll look for it. You're trusting me with this, so I'll help.
strings.감사합니다. 나중에 제국 일로 어려움을 겪으신다면 제가 도움을 드리겠습니: Thank you. If imperial affairs ever cause you trouble, I'll assist you. I will repay this kindness.
It's only finding a butterfly. You don't need to owe me anything... Anyway, I'll be back.
And once you find it, please take it to the princess.
strings.(나비 이야기를 하니 성소 쪽 분위기가 잠시 달라진 것 같네…. 일단 가: (The atmosphere around the sanctum seemed to change for a moment when we mentioned the butterfly... Shall I go?)
strings.%s 씨, 그건 뭐야? 나에게 줄 게 있는 거야?: %s, what's that? Do you have something for me?
Argent asked me to find this and bring it to you.
strings.아르젠트는 그때나 지금이나 정말 한결같다니까…. 언니만 신경 써도 될텐데: Argent hasn't changed at all... He could just concern himself with my sister. Sigh...
strings.바르바토스의 곁에서 맴돌던 검은 나비에요. 그게 있으면 예전에 있었던 일: The black butterfly that hovered around Barbatos. Argent said it might provide evidence about what happened in the past.
strings.맞아. 사실 나도 오래전부터 이걸 찾고 있었어. 그래서 이면을 찾아 계속: Yes. I've been searching for this for a long time too. That's why I kept exploring the Reverse Side.
strings.그동안 바르바토스는 모습을 보이지 않았는지 흔적을 찾을 수는 없었어. 그: I couldn't find any trace of Barbatos. He must not have shown himself. Then he appeared at the Sanctuary...
Thank you for finding it on the Sanctuary's Reverse Side. But look at this.
strings.나비처럼 생겼지만, 정확히는 모형이네?: It looks like a butterfly, but it's actually a model.
There seems to be some kind of spell on it that affects time and space.
strings.누군가의 도움이 필요해. 시간과 공간에 대한…. 아, 클로리스 교장은 안: We'll need someone's help. Someone who understands time and space... Principal Chloris won't do...
I may know someone who can offer advice.
Then I'll leave it to you.
Welcome. I was hoping for someone to talk to today. You've come at just the right time.
strings.무슨 이야기를 할까요? 원래 살던 곳은 어땠나요?: What shall we talk about? What was your homeland like?
strings.지엔디아 만큼 아름답고 밝고 사람들이 환하게 웃으며 다니는 그런 곳이었소: A place as bright and beautiful as Jiendia, where people walked about with radiant smiles.
It sounds like a lovely place to live.
strings.그렇소. 면 요리가 유명한 식당이 있었고…. 아, 그러고보니 점점 그곳의: It was. There was a restaurant famous for its noodles... Ah, come to think of it, my memories of that place are fading. I'd like to see it once more, though I cannot...
strings.하하, 내가 사실 시력을 잃은 것에 후회는 하지 않지만, 그래도 자랑은: Haha. I don't regret losing my sight, but allow me one little boast.
strings.워낙 눈이 좋아서 오른쪽 왼쪽 각각 4.0이오. 마법을 수련하면서 집중하: My eyesight was exceptional: 4.0 in each eye. Concentrating on my magical training improved it as well.
My eyes are good too, but I don't think they're that good...
Your heart sees more clearly than most. That is enough.
Anyway... Does Iris still smile? Of course she should, but...
Now, tell me why you've come.
strings.(사이암에게 검은 나비에 대한 이야기를 한다.): (I tell Siam about the black butterfly.)
strings.내가 가지고 있는 걸 주리다. 그러면 되겠소? 그게 도움이 될지 모르겠지: I'll give you something I have. Will that do? I don't know if it will help, but take it with you.
strings.대신, 나와 대련한 후에 가져가시오. 마침 몸을 좀 풀고 싶었으니. 준비: But spar with me first. I've been wanting to stretch my limbs. I need to prepare, so step outside and come back in.
And once you have it, leave this place immediately without another word.
Trust me and do as I say.
Then I'll step out and come back.
strings.(시공간이 흔들리고 있군…. 일단 멈춰야겠지….): (Time and space are trembling... I should stop it for now...)
strings.데이나 씨, 자리에 있었네요. 도움이 될만한 물건을 가지고 왔어요. 그런: Dayna, you're here. I brought something that might help. But why that expression?
strings.익숙한 느낌이 들어서 그래. 그러고 보니 이 물건, 모래시계…. 다른 세: It feels familiar. This object, an hourglass... It seems to come from another world...
strings.…혹시, 이리스 파티에 있던 그 마법사의 물건이야?: ...Does it belong to the mage who traveled with Iris?
I see. Yet it feels to me as though it was found on the Reverse Side...
Thank you for getting it. Let me look.
strings.내 지식으로는 잘 모르겠네. 경험이 모든 걸 말해줄 수 있을 거로 생각했: It's beyond my knowledge. I thought experience would tell me everything, but I'll have to leave this to someone who knows more than I do.
strings.이스트랜드의 그 인물이군. 그냥 내 추측인데, 그 남자. 혹시 다프네라는: That man from Eastland. Just a guess, but... is he connected to someone named Daphne?
strings.그렇군. 이제 실마리를 좀 찾을 수 있을 것 같아. 고마워, 그리고 미안: I see. I think we finally have a lead. Thank you. And I'm sorry.
strings.이건 우리 자매가 해야 하는 일이 맞는데, 어쩌면 %s 씨가 또 엮일 것: This should be for my sisters and me to handle, but you may end up drawn into it again, %s...
strings.너무 걱정하지 마. 나도 도울게. 그런데 이제 어디로 가?: Don't worry too much. I'll help too. Where are you headed now?
strings.…잘 모르겠어요. 누군가 부르면 또 그곳으로 가지 않을까요?: ...I'm not sure. If someone calls, I suppose I'll go there.
Thank you, Dayna. See you later. Maybe I'll get something to eat before I leave...
strings.갑자기 왜 이렇게 춥지? 꼭 얼어붙은 세계를 다녀온 것만 같은 느낌이야…: Why am I suddenly so cold? It feels as though I've just returned from a frozen world...
No, it must be my imagination. Sigh... Everything will be fine.
